prompt: Since the 02:00 deploy of orders-api v4.7, Postgres on db-orders-prod-1 logs ~30 'deadlock detected' errors/min between the orders and order_items tables and checkout success dropped to 91%. Find and stop the deadlocks.
On db-wallet-prod, p99 for POST /wallets/{id}/debit jumped from 25ms to 3.2s. The id w_acme_master, a shared corporate pooled wallet, appears in 70% of requests. No errors, just slow. Find why.
db-events-prod table event_log (ingest ~4k rows/s, heavy UPDATE) grew the data dir by 240GB in 6 days and seq scans are slow. Suspected bloat. Confirm and bring autovacuum back under control.
db-billing-prod alert: age(datfrozenxid) hit 1.95B and is climbing ~20M/hour, so the 2.1B forced read-only shutdown is ~7h out. The anti-wraparound vacuum appears stuck. Stop the wraparound.

db-analytics-prod: vacuum runs but pg_stat_user_tables shows dead tuples climbing on every table and nothing is reclaimed cluster-wide. Disk is at 88%. The ETL worker dbt-runner-7 is suspected. Free the dead tuples.
db-orders-replica fell out of the fleet last night; now db-orders-prod pg_wal is 380GB and climbing with disk at 92%. WAL is not being recycled. Stop the bleed before the disk fills.

db-search-prod: SELECT ... WHERE email=$1 on users (180M rows) regressed from 2ms to 140ms over the past month even though it still uses users_email_idx, and buffers read per query are 50x higher. Restore index performance.

A migration on db-users-prod adding a column to users keeps aborting after 30s with 'canceling statement due to statement timeout', and while it runs, app reads on users pile up and time out. Apply the ALTER safely without taking the app down.

db-catalog-prod went from healthy to nearly all queries timing out in 60s flat. pg_stat_activity shows 400 sessions 'active' but throughput is near zero. A teammate ran ALTER TABLE products ADD CONSTRAINT two minutes ago. Unblock the database.

db-reporting-prod: every query on daily_rollup has been hanging for 8 minutes. Disk had been high so the overnight 'reclaim space' cron ran something. Reads must come back now without corrupting the reclaim.

Our nightly billing-reconciler cron uses pg_advisory_lock(42) to guarantee a single runner. It has been stuck 'waiting for lock' for 3 nights even though no other reconciler is running. Connections go through PgBouncer in transaction mode. Make the job acquire its lock.

db-timeseries-prod: every ~3 days, read latency on metrics_2026 spikes 10x for ~40 minutes with a matching disk read-IOPS spike, then clears on its own. CPU is fine and it never lines up with a deploy. Explain and tame it.

db-orders-prod: bulk inserts into order_items (FK-references orders) are intermittently slow and a few deadlock with concurrent UPDATE orders SET status=.... This began after we added a total_cents trigger that updates the parent order row. Stop the contention.

db-docs-prod: table documents stores a large jsonb body; the table's own size looks stable but /pgdata grew 180GB this month and body UPDATEs are getting slower. Standard autovacuum on documents reports it is running fine. Find the hidden growth.
